tagline.en_US: Emby Server is a personal media server that organizes personal videos, music, and photos into a centralized library.

description.en_US: Emby Server is a personal media server that organizes personal videos, music, and photos into a centralized library. It converts and streams multimedia content to connected client devices across local networks or the internet. The platform includes a web interface for browsing collections, managing metadata, and playing back media across supported devices.
